capabilities: collect daily notes into a two-column vertical timeline
open a day's note from a preview card or date label
zoom between month and year aggregation
rate a day's energy and mood with an echo-interaction code block
step through adjacent daily notes with a prev/next bar
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.5.7 or newer; works on desktop and mobile. The README flags that the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Daily notes live as separate files, so reviewing months or years of journaling in one place is hard.
summary: Daily-notes viewer that gathers all daily notes into one scrollable vertical timeline with preview cards, month/year zoom, and prev/next navigation.
